name: hero_sheet

refs.label: style reference only: match its art style, rendering, palette and light; do not copy its composition

prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGES (attached in this order):
Image 1 = style reference only: match its art style, rendering, palette and light; do not copy its composition

STYLE BIBLE: hand-drawn comic-book 2D game art matching Image 1: chunky readable cartoon shapes with slightly exaggerated proportions; cel shading with 2-3 hard-edged tones per material plus a small hard highlight, light grainy brush texture inside fills; dark warm-brown ink outline (#261215) of even medium weight around every object and on major interior forms, thinner interior lines; desaturated night palette: cool blue-violet and slate shadows (#161624, #2a3550), muted grey-blue metals, warm amber-orange local light (#f6bc56) only where a lamp hits, small saturated accents on actors and props; detail only at focal points, big quiet shapes elsewhere; matte surfaces, not a 3D render, no photorealism.
Light: soft cool ambient from above, key light from the upper left, lit faces slightly lighter and warmer, shadow sides cool blue; no cast shadows painted on the ground.
Strict top-down 3/4 view, camera about 50 degrees above the ground, orthographic, objects show their top and their front face.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no glow, no light rays, no cast shadows, no frame.

ASSET:
Use case: a character PART SHEET for cut-out rig animation in a top-down 3/4 survivors-like game set inside a datacenter at night.
Image 1 is the style reference only (line, shading, palette, light); do not copy its subjects.
Subject: the mascot of a software company called Utrace: a chunky cartoon letter U standing upright; the left prong is coral red, the right prong is teal cyan, the rounded bowl at the bottom is dark navy; the prong tops are lighter flat caps; a simple friendly cartoon face (two big white eyes with black pupils and a small smile) sits on the front of the navy bowl.
Draw the SAME character split into separate parts, front 3/4 view, all on one canvas:
- top row, centred: the BODY alone, with NO legs and NO arms (the hip and shoulder areas are closed and complete), facing the viewer;
- bottom row, left to right, each part drawn straight and vertical, complete:
  1) ONE LEG: a single straight stubby leg (thigh and shin in one piece, a slight knee crease in the middle), hip end at the top, ankle at the bottom, NO foot, colour dark navy;
  2) ONE FOOT: a single chunky cartoon shoe seen from the side, toe pointing right, colour off-white;
  3) ONE ARM: a single straight arm hanging down, shoulder end at the top, a round mitten hand at the bottom, colour dark navy with a off-white hand;
  4) A HANDHELD BARCODE SCANNER GUN pointing right: yellow-orange body, a red scan window at the right end, a dark grey grip hanging below the back of the body.
Composition: every part separate with very wide empty gaps (at least 80 px) between parts, nothing touching or overlapping, nothing cut by the canvas edge.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no numbers on any part, no ground, no shadow, no glow.

Canvas: 1536x1024 px (3:2 landscape); if that exact size is unavailable, use the closest size with the same aspect ratio.

Background: fully transparent (real alpha channel, PNG) everywhere outside the ASSET, with clean anti-aliased edges; no ground or cast shadow beyond what the ASSET describes, no frame, no checkerboard pattern
